caption.text:
Carousels are the only format on Instagram that survives being scrolled past.

Instagram can re-serve your post starting at slide 2, which is why the second frame has to hook as hard as the first. These six slides run that loop on purpose:

01 One promise, twelve words
02 A second entry point
03 Proof before the ask
04 A recap people screenshot

Save this and run it on your next deck.
